messages:
maria: Noticed 3 short p95 spikes across prod GPU pools in last 48h. Pattern looks like "arrhythmia" not gradual drift. Need SLO tune + owners.

maria: p95 spikes ~3x baseline for 30-90s windows at ~02:10, 09:05, 15:40 UTC. Error budget burned ~12% in 48h for a few routes. No deploys. Suspect KV cache warm + bursty traffic.

aj: suggest adding a 24h operational SLO to detect regression earlier, separate from 30d contractual SLO.

devon: also add a short-window alert (3m p95 > 300ms) to notify ops before contract impacts.

kevin: I can own dashboards + alert. Will add 3m/15m panels, weekly spike-frequency metric, PD rule for 3m. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial changes.

maria: propose error-budget automation: if burn rate >4x over 6h, auto-pause noncritical rollouts and notify stakeholders.

devon: action item: instrument KV cache miss rate and per-request batch size histogram. Spikes correlate with elevated KV misses in sampled traces.

aj: I'll draft the 24h SLO doc (set at 110% of monthly target to avoid flip-flop) and own runbook checklist.

kevin: creating tracker tasks now: dashboard+alert (kevin, +1d); 24h SLO draft (aj, +4d); error-budget automation (maria, +7d); telemetry (devon, +14d).

oncall-bot: incident 2026-04-12T15:41:07Z severity:S3 closed 1tags:latency-spike kv-cache

maria: quick sync tomorrow 10:30 UTC (15m) to confirm dashboards + SLO draft?

kevin: +1

devon: +1
